To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) brand image is a significant predictor of brand equity; (b) brand attachment and brand equity partially mediate the brand image brand equity relationship; (c) brand attitude and awareness are not significant predictors of brand equity; and (d) the relationship between brand equity and the three drivers of brand image varies across different product categories and WOM.
Brand image is a strong driver of brand equity.

(1) brand image positively influences brand attachment, brand awareness, and brand attitude; (2) brand attachment and brand attitudes have a positive impact on consumer based brand equity; (3) brand attachment and attitude partially mediate between brand image and consumer based brand equity, (4) brand image and consumer-based brand equity are influenced by product type and WOM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
brand image as a predictor of brand equity and the mediating role and moderating effects on the relationship between brand equity and brand image.

brand image and brand attitude and how these two dimensions influence the brand equity construct and the moderating roles that product type and WOM play in the relationships among brand equity dimensions.
the mediating and moderating effects in the brand image-brand equity relationship.

this study has made an important contribution in the area of branding and brand equity.
brand image and brand attitude have a significant impact on brand equity.
brand image is an essential factor for building consumer based brand equity and the drivers of brand equity play a significant role in the process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
brand image is an important driver of brand equity and brand image is positively related to the drivers of brand equity.
brand equity is an important asset to the organization, and it is a result of brand image, brand attachment, brand awareness, brand attitude, WOM, and product type.
brand image is an antecedent of brand equity, but the relationship between brand equity drivers and brand equity is not straightforward.

brand managers should be aware of the drivers of brand equity and how these drivers are influenced by product type and WOM.
managers should pay attention to the brand image, brand attitude, brand attachment and brand awareness in their brand management strategies.
brand managers should pay more attention to the brand image and brand attachment and brand attitudes in their brand equity management.
